parties.title: Celebrate at YezYY
parties.subtitle: A guided DIY party in Glen Waverley, planned with a real person from our studio.
parties.setupCleanup: 30-minute setup and 30-minute cleanup handled by staff
parties.minimumSpend: A$45 minimum DIY spend per participant
parties.includedGift: A surprise gift for the birthday child, selected by staff from a plush toy, Lego set, or toy
parties.includedVoucher: 15% in-store voucher, excluding Pop Mart, venue fees, and booking-related charges
parties.byoBody: Bring cake, drinks, food, and snacks.
parties.paymentTitle: Request first. Pay in store after confirmation.
parties.paymentBody: The venue fee is also the deposit. There is no online payment.
parties.refund: Cancel at least 48 hours before the final guest start for a full venue-fee refund. Later cancellation is non-refundable.
parties.timeRequest: Your preferred time is a request only. Staff may confirm it or propose another time.

partyBookingForm.title: Request this party package
partyBookingForm.requestOnly: Choose a preferred guest start. This is a request only; YezYY staff must manually confirm it and may propose another time.
partyBookingForm.manualPayment: The venue fee/deposit is paid in store after staff confirmation. There is no online payment.
partyBookingForm.name: Contact name
partyBookingForm.projectSpend: Every participant chooses at least one DIY project, with a minimum DIY spend of A$45 per participant.
partyBookingForm.scheduleHelp: Candidate starts use Australia/Melbourne time. Staff also plans the 30-minute setup and cleanup blocks.
partyBookingForm.noTimes: No candidate starts are available on this date. Try another date or contact YezYY.
partyBookingForm.availabilityError: Could not check party request times.
partyBookingForm.byoHelp: You may bring cake, drinks, food, and snacks.
partyBookingForm.cakeCutting: Add staff cake cutting for A$15
partyBookingForm.additionalCharges: Cleaning is A$15–A$35 only when applicable. Party overtime of 15–30 minutes is A$15–A$35 only when applicable; staff records the final amount.
partyBookingForm.policySummary: The A$95 or A$145 venue fee is also the deposit and is paid in store after confirmation. A full venue-fee refund is available when cancellation is requested at least 48 hours before the final guest start. Later cancellation is non-refundable.
partyBookingForm.policyConsent: I accept the party, age, supervision, payment, cancellation, refund, and privacy policies.
partyBookingForm.successBody: Your request awaits manual staff confirmation. We may propose another time. Pay the venue fee/deposit in store; no online payment was taken.
partyBookingForm.error: Could not send your request. Try again or contact us.
partyBookingForm.birthdayAgeError: The birthday child must be at least 5.
partyBookingForm.projectRequired: Choose at least one DIY project.
partyBookingForm.policyRequired: Accept the party booking policies to continue.

customerBooking.title: Manage your YezYY request
customerBooking.intro: Only the actions currently available for this booking are shown below. Every change is reviewed by YezYY staff.
customerBooking.invalidTitle: This booking link is not available
customerBooking.invalidBody: The link may be invalid, expired, or no longer available. Contact YezYY for help.
customerBooking.acceptHelp: Accepting records your agreement and creates a temporary party hold. Pay the venue fee/deposit in store; there is no online payment.
customerBooking.experienceCancellationHelp: A request made at least two hours before the start is eligible for free cancellation. Later requests are at staff discretion.
customerBooking.partyCancellationHelp: A request made at least 48 hours before the final guest start is eligible for a full venue-fee refund. Later cancellation is non-refundable. Staff reviews and records the outcome.
customerBooking.rescheduleHelp: Choose a preferred date and 30-minute start. This sends a request only; staff makes the final change.
customerBooking.rescheduleWindowInvalid: Choose a time at least two hours from now and within the next seven Melbourne calendar days.
customerBooking.pendingBody: Your request was recorded and awaits staff review. YezYY will contact you about the next step. No online payment was taken.
customerBooking.noActions: There are no customer actions available for this booking. Contact YezYY if you need help.
customerBooking.actionError: This action could not be recorded. The link may no longer be available; contact YezYY for help.
